Bonk the Boykisser is basically like a Vampire Survivors clone but with boys who want to kiss you. Armed only with your trusty baseball bat you must survive hordes of boykissers who get stronger and faster with each passing minute. It's like being transported into your own personal hell (or heaven, if you're a fellow boykisser) where every single minute is spent fighting for your life. Unfortunately for me, after years of playing this game (85 minutes) my muscle memory kicked in and when my own cat tried to jump onto my lap I immediately clubbed him away from me, due to fear of being kissed by a boy. May he rest in peace but also I will not be caught lacking. I didn't even have a milkshake so I don't know why these boys are in my yard. Perhaps some perverse god has sent them from the depths of purgatory in some vain attempt to disrupt my sexuality, but I shall remain pure. Boykissers rejected, virginity protected.

Much like in real life, if you run far enough, the anti-boykisser forcefields activate and they cannot get you. Also like in real life, the boykissers get stronger until they are so strong, that they will catch you, and they will kiss you. This game represents my goals in life. I give this a "oooh you like kissing boys don't you" out of boykisser. Play it.

Nevermind, it's apparently making use of generative AI... So far, I do think this game is quite fun actually. Still early access, and the content is slim enough to get like, all achievements in about an hour to two, but for the reasonable price, it's not bad at all! The gameplay loop is simple, and might be a bit repetitive, but I've been enjoying it. It's nothing super commital, so hopping on for a round or two when you have nothing else to do at the moment is totally doable. Looking forward to seeing what becomes of the game.

Fun game but hell why does it need to use 100% of GPU. I do hope that there will be some update that limits FPS or do some other optimizations. For now I will leave a negative review but if there will be an update that fixes that insane GPU usage then I will change this review to positive one. I somehow doubt that dev will fix that because his previous game seems to have the exact same problem. According to discussions even after the game leaving its early access phase this problem was not fixed. Boykisser deserves to be in a better game or at least more optimized game.

[h1]个人评分[6.0分][/h1] [url=https://go-furry.com/games/247] ฅ单击此处写下您的观点ฅ [/url] [h2]辱华的作者，永远不会得到中国的尊重[/h2] 在删除《ESCAPE FROM BOYKISSER》里面赤裸裸侮辱中国的政治内容之前这篇评测将永远不会改为好评 以及BOYKISSER的作者因为被网暴至死，将其生前唯一重要的东西作为怪物逃离或是暴力对待，无异于吃着人血馒头，这样的暴行其心可诛，任何一个有良知的正常人都应该尊重生命。 [h2]略带一点心理恐怖的休闲游戏[/h2] 这一类玩法的手机休闲游戏约莫10-15年前有玩过，同样的有限区域无缝拼接地图加点局内成长，玩法上几乎没有什么改变甚至还少了很多很多内容，比如装扮、道具、以及一些局外养成系统，除了本身怪物比较可爱以外想不出还有多少值得夸奖的地方。 不过从低廉的价格上来看还算是一款性价比较高的休闲游戏，从游戏的角度来看是一款合格的作品。 [h3]不过游戏的受众始终存疑？[/h3] 作为一个深度参与兽圈活动的多领域作者以及游戏阅历超过20年的资深兽游玩家，我无法分辨这是一款虐待兽人还是兽人爱好者的作品。评论区也有不少厌恶福瑞且以殴打报复福瑞为乐的人，这样看来该作更像是一个刷怪笼，刷新的不只有BOYKISSER，还有披着人类外衣行径却比野兽更卑劣的恶魔。 [hr][/hr] [quote] [h3][b]⬇⬇⬇欢迎关注 GF兽游资讯站ฅ•̀∀•́ฅ [table] [tr] [td] 欢迎关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41161293/] 獣人控的游戏鉴赏🐺随缘更新⚣ [/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] 欢迎订阅 [url=https://space.bilibili.com/37124259] 百兽发布的频道😺 [/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] 世界最全的兽人控导航站 [url=https://go-furry.com] GoFurry🐲 [/url][/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] Steam区兽游互助群 [url=s.team]656379850[/url][/td] [/tr] [/table] [/b][/h3] [/quote]
